author: weixu-zhang
description:
VisRL benchmark eval results — VisPlotBench per-sample outputs
	

Companion to github.com/weixuzhang/visrl
and weixu-zhang/visrl-data.
This repo holds the per-sample outputs of VisPlotBench
runs for 5 trained checkpoints, so the GPT-4.1 visual judge or the
custom HTML/vegalite/lilypond stats path can be re-run from these
artifacts without regenerating the model outputs.

	
		
	
	
		Layout
	

{model}/
├── {lang}.json                                      summary stats from the bench… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/weixu-zhang/visrl-bench-results.
